scenes.setting: The twelfth crime scene, mid-feast: a black dog balloons into a winged, horned Devil — its 'Die!' burns a paper substitute rusty, its delayed fireball shatters the street, and Klein escapes through an illusion, a fireplace Flaming Jump, and good old screams of 'Murder!'
scenes.text_anchor: It really is an animal! It's a Sequence 6 Devil

scenes.setting: The getaway carriage climbs a road of pea vines into the sky: the museum woman, black boots dangling from a vine hammock, interrogates him — truthful answers pass her invisible search, and she leaves a warning: the Master Key carries a curse
scenes.text_anchor: “That key has a certain curse. It must not be used unless absolutely necessary.”

scenes.setting: Morning headlines scream 'The twelfth case!' while the museum theft gets a blurb; behind bathroom steam Klein ascends and finally holds the emperor-figured bookmark: 'It really wasn't easy getting you!'
scenes.text_anchor: Klein sat down and picked up the bookmark that depicted the figure of Emperor Roselle.
